summary: Backend-only testing of (a) auto-save of datum_prestanka_override on POST /api/documents/generate for 'prestanak' templates and (b) new GET /api/employees/history-by-jmbg. Created /app/backend/tests/test_employment_history_and_autosave.py with 10 tests - all passed. Full regression of 5 existing pytest files (29 tests) also passed. Total 39/39 backend tests green. Verified real cross-company history for JMBG 2301996220017 (EGZON CEKA, 2 records: PR. ARSIM CEKOVIĆ STR REA 2026-07-01 + SUMA FRESH MARKET DOO). Restored EGZON CEKA state (aktivan=true, datum_prestanka='') after tests; no leftover TEST_ data.

minor.issue: Side-effect on seeded data: existing regression test tests/test_rjesenje_prestanak_override.py::test_override_from_modal generates the prestanak template for the real employee EGZON CEKA (63283aaa-...) with datum_prestanka_override=2026-12-31. With the new auto-save this now permanently sets datum_prestanka=2026-12-31 and aktivan=false on the seeded employee, moving him to Arhiva. I restored the state manually, but that test should be changed to use a throwaway employee.

Records with empty datum_pocetka sort last (string sort). EGZON's SUMA FRESH MARKET DOO record has datum_pocetka='' so 'Datum prijave' will render blank in the HistoryModal — data-quality/UX nit, not a code bug.

action_items: Optional: change tests/test_rjesenje_prestanak_override.py::test_override_from_modal to create its own temp employee instead of mutating seeded EGZON CEKA (auto-save now makes that test destructive).
Optional: extract the shared arhiva_reason/status computation (duplicated between list_employees and history-by-jmbg) into a helper.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-save block (server.py ~2680) is correctly gated on 'prestank' in template name AND non-empty stripped override; verified all 4 branches by test.
Route /employees/history-by-jmbg is correctly declared before /employees/{employee_id}, so no path-param shadowing.
All history records exclude MongoDB _id (verified in assertion); auth is enforced (403 without token) and missing jmbg returns 422, short jmbg 400.
seed_data_creation: Temporary employees TEST AUTOSAVEONE/TWO/THREE/FOUR and TEST HISTORYOLD/HISTORYNEW (jmbg 9911223344556) created and deleted in module teardown. EGZON CEKA restored to aktivan=true, datum_prestanka=''.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_employment_history_and_autosave.py (classes TestAutoSaveDatumPrestanka, TestHistoryByJmbg). Frontend HistoryModal (data-testid=history-modal, history-person-<id>) in Persons.jsx and the Documents.jsx toast were NOT UI-tested — request was backend-only. Use JMBG 2301996220017 for a real 2-company history when testing the modal. Beware: generating the prestanak template with an override for a real employee now archives them.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only observed data mutation of seeded employee EGZON CEKA was caused by the pre-existing regression test now triggering the new auto-save path; restored post-run.
